title: BxCachy
tagline: Your developer machine, set up in minutes.

pages.title: Desktop
pages.intro: Hyprland with Noctalia is the BxCachy desktop. KDE Plasma stays on your machine either way; it is only configured if you choose it.

questions.label: Which desktops should BxCachy set up?
questions.help: KDE Plasma is never removed. Choosing Hyprland leaves it untouched.

options.label: Hyprland + Noctalia (recommended)
options.description: A fast tiling desktop with a polished shell. Keyboard-first, Mac-style Super keys. KDE Plasma is left as it is.

options.label: Both: Hyprland + Noctalia, and KDE Plasma with BxCachy tiling
options.description: Configure both with the shared BxCachy keys, and pick which one starts at login.

options.label: KDE Plasma with BxCachy tiling only
options.description: Keep Plasma and add HyprKwin tiling on top. Toggle it any time with: bxcachy tiling on|off.

questions.label: Which one starts when you log in?
questions.help: Sets the login screen's preselected session. You can still switch there.

options.label: Hyprland + Noctalia
options.description: The login screen preselects Hyprland.

options.label: KDE Plasma
options.description: The login screen preselects Plasma.

questions.label: How should windows behave in Hyprland?
questions.help: The default layout. You can change it later in hyprland.lua.

options.label: Tiling (recommended)
options.description: Windows split the screen on their own, no overlapping. Hyprland's default layout, called dwindle.

options.label: Tiling with a master window
options.description: One big window on the left, the others stacked beside it.

options.label: Scrolling (carousel)
options.description: Windows sit in columns on a strip you scroll sideways, like niri.

options.label: Floating windows
options.description: Normal overlapping windows you move and resize, like macOS. Tiling stays one keypress away.

questions.label: Workspaces always shown
questions.help: Empty workspaces stay visible in the bar.

questions.label: Database passwords
questions.help: Generated for you, or one you choose. Applies to the databases you picked; the admin user name is fixed per database.

options.label: Generated (recommended)
options.description: A strong random password for each, kept in a private file. Show it any time with: bxcachy db info ENGINE --show-password

options.label: My own password
options.description: You type it (twice, hidden) as each database starts. Databases with no password (Redis, Chroma, Qdrant, Weaviate, Couchbase) are not asked.

pages.title: Import
pages.intro: Bring your own dotfiles. This runs last, so your files win over BxCachy's starter configs.

questions.label: Dotfiles repository (optional)
questions.help: A git URL or a local path. Leave empty to skip.

questions.label: How it works
questions.help: BxCachy detects whether the repository uses chezmoi, yadm, stow or plain files. Nothing is replaced without asking: files you already have are listed, and each one is backed up first. Undo any time with: bxcachy dotfiles undo.
